Don't worry about antivirus and task killers as long as you keep on reputable sites and use play store apps you should be fine.

I don't have any recommendations for apps really. I use a clock widget for my home screen called "Transparent Clock Widget". Google keyboard instead of the stock one. Pandora, iHeart Radio, Peel Smart Remote (control your TV if you have an IR blaster), Podkicker (podcasts). Vivino is a neat app for wine if you're a wine person. If you don't want to see your bloatware (preloaded apps you can't uninstall) you can disable them in your app manager.

Also most utilities have an app. I pay my electric, phone, cable/internet with their respected apps. If you have a business you like odds are they have an app now.
